highlights:
## 🧠 Keep the conversation going

Long chats and model changes now recover better when a model runs out of room. Nod summarizes older context or saves a short checkpoint, while the full chat stays available to search. Large tool results stay in workspace files instead of filling the next request. If your current request alone is too large, Nod asks you to choose a model with more room or reset the conversation. [Models and context](https://nod.n8n.io/docs/connect/models/#models-with-a-small-context-window)

## 🪟 A little more Nod on Windows

Windows gets Nod's own title bar, with colors that follow your light or dark theme. You can also choose **Replay onboarding…** from the tray icon to connect to another server. [Desktop app](https://nod.n8n.io/docs/deploy/desktop-app/)

## Also in this release

- **Usage:** Activity times follow your computer's time zone, so the log reads in your local time.
- **Gmail:** Before you approve deleting a draft, Nod identifies the draft. It checks the target again before deletion.
- **Model changes:** OpenAI-compatible servers can read tool history left by another model.
